question: The apparent position of a star keeps on changing slightly because:

options.text: the physical conditions of the atmosphere are stationary
the atmosphere consists of a mixture of gases
the physical conditions of the atmosphere keep changing

solution:
The correct answer is __**the physical conditions of the atmosphere keep changing**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The apparent position of a star keeps on changing slightly because **the physical conditions of the atmosphere keep changing**.
 
• This phenomenon is known as **stellar scintillation or twinkling**.
